entities.name: PMID:25075057
observations: Retrospective cohort of 214 localized primary gastric GISTs resected without adjuvant therapy; exoluminal or mixed type independently predicted recurrence (HR 3.7, p=0.043), alongside size >3.5 cm and mitotic rate >5/50 HPF.

entities.name: PMID:33651216
observations: Population-based cohort of 295 resected gastric GISTs: transmural growth had worse 5-year RFS than luminal/exophytic growth (71% vs 96%; HR 8.45, 95% CI 3.69-19.36; p<0.001).

entities.name: PMID:37120543
observations: For 2-5 cm gastric GISTs, exogenous growth correlated with worse PFS by Kaplan-Meier analysis; adjusted independent PFS predictors were Ki-67, surgical history, and resection style, not growth pattern.
